correctnessFindings.assessment: The legacy importer already rejected sources over 16 MiB at stat time. It now counts raw streamed bytes during the read, closing the race where a file grows after that stat.

Removing the stream UTF-8 encoding lets the budget count actual source bytes; the existing StringDecoder preserves split multi-byte sequences. Other decodeTranscriptStream callers retain the default Infinity allowance.
A limit failure is caught by the existing import failure path instead of committing a partial successful import. The existing 64-subagent allowance is unchanged.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: Normal allowed-size imports produce the same messages. A source that grows beyond the existing 16 MiB allowance while being read now fails import rather than consuming the enlarged file.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: Enforcement of the existing whole-source import limit; no new record limit or lower source quota. Source data remains on disk.

platformEvidence.assessment: Raw Node stream byte accounting and StringDecoder are portable APIs. Fresh tests ran on macOS; filesystem growth semantics on native Linux and Windows were not separately executed.
platformEvidence.executedHost: Fresh shared batch: macOS darwin arm64; Node 26.6.0. PRs outside that batch have no new execution in this follow-up.

originalReview.sshAndFolderCases: The existing execution-host import path owns its source file. No remote shell, process status, or Git-worktree assumption is introduced.

regressionCoverage.description: The fresh batch includes journal-legacy-import-source-bound and transcript-stream-lines, covering read-time growth and framing/UTF-8 behavior. Static review confirms the budget is passed only by the already capped importer.

rootFocusedBatch.boundary: Root ran the current worktree after checking affected product bytes against nine published heads. Installed dependencies and transitive imports are current; this is not an exact historical full-source-graph execution. The 133 count is shared by the batch, not repeated per PR.

regressionCoverage.limitations: This does not bound all decoded message objects under every caller: decodeTranscriptStream defaults to Infinity elsewhere. Native filesystem race execution is limited to the macOS host.
